name: Er-Lang God
description: Erlang Shen, also known as Yang Jian, appears in "Journey to the West", "The Romance of the Gods", "Strange Stories from a Chinese Studio" and other literary works. He is the nephew of the Jade Emperor, but he grew up in the human world. In order to split the mountain to save his mother, he studied under a teacher and traveled all over the world in search of the powerful treasure mountain axe. Finally, he split the peach mountain and reunited with his mother. Erlang Shen has unrivaled martial arts skills, immense strength, and possesses seventy-two transformations of extraordinary mana; his three-pointed, two-edged spear and the third divine eye on his forehead are his symbols.
